description: This file implements the core functionality for sending packed objects and updates to a remote repository in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for packing objects, communicating ref statuses, signing push certificates, and managing sideband communication. It appears to be a central part of the 'send-pack' command logic.

methods.name: int option_parse_push_signed(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses and sets the push signed option based on user input or unset flag.

methods.name: void feed_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,FILE * fh,int negative)
methods.description: Feeds a single object (by oid) into the pack stream, optionally indicating negative reference.

methods.name: int pack_objects(struct repository * r,int fd,struct ref * refs,struct oid_array * advertised,struct oid_array * negotiated,struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Creates a pack stream of objects and writes it to the specified file descriptor, handling process spawning, feeding objects, and collecting errors.

methods.name: int receive_unpack_status(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads and interprets the remote unpack status from a packet stream.

methods.name: int receive_status(struct repository * r,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref * refs)
methods.description: Processes the status feedback from remote after an update attempt, updating refs with remote status and handling options.

methods.name: int sideband_demux(int in UNUSED,int out,void * data)
methods.description: Demultiplexes sideband data from the remote, forwarding it to the appropriate output.

methods.name: int advertise_shallow_grafts_cb(const struct commit_graft * graft,void * cb)
methods.description: Callback for advertising shallow grafts, writing shallow commit info into a buffer.

methods.name: void advertise_shallow_grafts_buf(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Builds a buffer with shallow graft info for shallow repositories.

methods.name: int check_to_send_update(const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Determines whether a reference should be sent, considering its status and push options.

methods.name: const char * next_line(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Finds the start of the next line in a buffer, or the end if incomplete.

methods.name: int generate_push_cert(struct strbuf * req_buf,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct send_pack_args * args,const char * cap_string,const char * push_cert_nonce)
methods.description: Generates and signs a push certificate based on remote references and push options.

methods.name: void reject_invalid_nonce(const char * nonce,int len)
methods.description: Validates the format of a push certificate nonce to ensure safety.

methods.name: void get_commons_through_negotiation(struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)
methods.description: Performs a fetch negotiation to determine common objects with the remote repository.

methods.name: int send_pack(struct repository * r,struct send_pack_args * args,int fd[],struct child_process * conn,struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Main function to push updates, create pack data, communicate with remote refs, handle negotiation, signing, and transfer of objects and ref statuses.

ctags.name: check_to_send_update
ctags.pattern: /^static int check_to_send_update(const struct ref *ref, const struct send_pack_args *args)$/
ctags.signature: (const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)

ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)

ctags.name: option_parse_push_signed
ctags.signature: (const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)

ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,int fd,struct ref * refs,struct oid_array * advertised,struct oid_array * negotiated,struct send_pack_args * args)
